name: CamSettingsFlags
meaning: Bits of g_camSettings 0x6e45e4 (value 0x2E), tested by absolute address in this module

name: CAMSET_COLLISION
meaning: eye sweep, TOO-FAR and cut logic enabled (Camera_SolveCollision)

name: CAMSET_LEDGE_PROBE_CAMYAW
meaning: ledge probe uses the camera yaw instead of the request yaw (clear in 0x2E)

name: CAMSET_AUTO_YAW_FOLLOW
meaning: with no input, yaw swings behind the target's velocity at a rate proportional to the angle error * g_camAutoYawGain * speed factor
